name: SshDaemon
blurb: Transfer files to/from your home in a secure well proven way using the ssh/sftp subsystem.
description:
Transfer files to/from your home in a secure well proven way using the ssh/sftp subsystem. You will need a client like WinSCP or Filezilla on your desktop machine.

Features:

* No root required
* based on the Apache Mina project
* very fast transfer rates.
